what: The texts that semble 0.7.2's default install for Claude Code would put into every session, taken from semble's source, with their sizes. A reconstruction: `semble install` was never run, and no session was measured before and after.
source: https://github.com/MinishLab/semble at tag v0.7.2, commit bb746c9c79925760df8a3759fcca658734e2eaf6
counted: 2026-11-13, with 0001_count_tokens.py (sha256 a8dcf1e4dedd1ded41652e6b3a3291094279b4857cf0d6c1e3ea587bc80f7502) under Python 3.14.10, after its --self-test passed. Encoding o200k_base, OpenAI's vocabulary (file sha256 446a9538cb6c348e3516120d7c08b09f57c36495e2acfffe59a5bf8b0cfb1a2d), used as a proxy: these are not Claude's own counts.
texts: Not published: they are semble's. Each row says where its text comes from in the source, and gives the sha256 of the text's UTF-8 bytes. The five texts read from source files were derived again from the tag for this count and were byte for byte the saved ones.

default_install.from: json.dumps of the two tools (search, find_related) that semble.mcp.create_server lists, each as model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True): what the harness's inprocess step builds, with the mcp extra. Saved when the harness ran and not rebuilt for this count; its length is tool_definitions_chars in 0001-results.json.
INSTRUCTIONS in src/semble/installer/agents.py, with the pin an install from PyPI gives, semble[mcp]==0.7.2
description in the front matter of src/semble/agents/claude.md

skill_variant.from: description in the front matter of src/semble/agents/skill.md
